messages.subject: Morpho createAtlas
parts:
I am trying to replicate the methods discussed in Bardua et al. 2019 that was employed in Bardua et al. 2019 for my snake skull data set. I have been able to call a template skull .ply and .pts file that includes single landmark points, semi-landmark curve points, and surface points that were applied as single points in Checkpoint. I have also been able to call in a .ply and .pts for a skull with the single points and curves but no surface points. 

So far I have been able to sub-sample the curves and am now moving toward applying the surface points from the template skull to the other. I eventually want to employ Morpho's placePatch but am currently stuck on Morpho's createAtlas. The documentation for the argument 'patch' mentions a 'matrix containing semi-landmarks'. Should this matrix just be of the surface points? is there an easy way to define this from the template pts file? should an atlas be made for each patch of surface points I intend to place on subsequent skulls? I would appreciate it if someone could share what the patch argument matrix should look like. 

I apologize if this isn't the right place to ask questions associated with Morpho but I haven't been able to find another group like this.
